mutations.name: an A/B side never shows as picked
kills: an A/B question records the side picked, by its button or its digit key

mutations.name: a sent Neither never shows as pressed
kills: an A/B question reads a sent Neither and its option note back after a reload, locked (TP-3767)

mutations.name: the two sides stack at every width
kills: an A/B question lays its two options side by side, each with its own frame, pick and note

mutations.name: a further option such as Both picks side A instead
kills: an A/B question offers the round's further option, such as Both, as a pick

mutations.name: the check screen sends while the server would refuse the round
kills: an A/B question sends Neither as a revision request, once the comment says what to change

mutations.name: only the first option note is sent
kills: an A/B question sends a note per side in optionNotes, and typing a digit in a note picks nothing
